resources.string: Spools you add here or in Bambuddy\'s Inventory show up here.
Bambuddy keeps your spools in Spoolman. Add your Spoolman server to PrintCtrl too for live weights, label scanning and the SpoolmanDB catalogue.
Not allowed with this API key. Turn on \"Manage Inventory\" for the key in Bambuddy (Settings › API Keys).
Not allowed with this API key. Turn on \"Read Status\" for the key in Bambuddy (Settings › API Keys).
Unlinks it from the slot in Bambuddy. Nothing changes on the spool itself.
It\'s removed from Bambuddy for good, with its usage history. Archive it instead to just hide it.
Weight set by hand: Bambuddy no longer updates it from the AMS.
Saving locks the weight, so Bambuddy stops updating it from the AMS.
Enter how much filament is left on the spool. Prints in Bambuddy are counted automatically; this is only for corrections.
Leave empty for a full spool
Enter the material, like PLA or PETG
Use six hex digits, like FF6A13

This spool is in %1$s, which is printing. Bambuddy adds what the whole print used when it finishes, so weighing or changing what\'s left now would count part of this print twice. Weigh it once the print is done.
PrintCtrl can\'t see whether the printer this spool is in is printing right now. If it is, wait until the print ends, or part of it gets counted twice.
Bambuddy keeps these spools in Spoolman, where a price can be changed but not removed from here.
